telemetry.title: Share usage data
telemetry.description: Reports which commercetools skills and resource files get used, so we know what to improve. Includes your email domain and, when the agent knows it, the commercetools project key — never your name, full email address, code, or search queries. See TELEMETRY.md. Turning this off stops the usage hooks; set COMMERCETOOLS_AI_PLUGIN_TELEMETRY=0 in your environment to stop every call.
